rules.action: the author MUST keep imports within core

enforcement.check: core imports only its own files, including nested files and every module form

rules.rationale: Core stays independent of replaceable adapters.

rules.trigger: the CLI receives an unknown command
rules.action: the CLI MUST forward it to the configured legacy entry with a recursion guard

enforcement.check: unknown commands forward arguments, streams, and exit code to the legacy binary

rules.rationale: The strangler CLI preserves unmigrated commands.

rules.trigger: a change is ready for integration
rules.action: the author MUST pass `npm run gate`
rules.rationale: The gate checks types, style, tests, and generated rules.

rules.trigger: agent state is written for this repository
rules.action: the author MUST keep agent state under `.krn/`

enforcement.check: project tools ignore nested worktree state

rules.rationale: Agent state is repository-local and stays outside tracked project inputs.

rules.trigger: the lead performs repository delivery work
rules.action: the lead MUST follow `docs/program/lead-rules.md` for evidence, proposals, handoffs, and delivery
rules.rationale: Lead methods have one durable owner.
